now: the hall tab has a rename box and a retire row: hold to retire pays 250 a level into lifetime earnings, moves worn gear to the stash, puts the pillager in the hall and opens the birth card (keys and pad get a confirm card, one raid needed first); the title name is the account name in menus, save slots and the lobby; the partner sees the pillager name with numeral over the head; the run card names the pillager; restore codes carry the lineage and old codes still restore
